title: Mobile Size
description: Briefly resize the captured tab to phone width after desktop outputs, letting active response and WACZ recorders save responsive assets.

MOBILESIZE_ENABLED.description: Enable the supplementary phone-width capture pass

MOBILESIZE_TIMEOUT.description: Hook timeout in seconds, including connection and viewport restoration

MOBILESIZE_WIDTH.description: Temporary viewport width in CSS pixels

MOBILESIZE_HEIGHT.description: Temporary viewport height in CSS pixels

MOBILESIZE_WAIT.description: Maximum seconds to wait for responsive requests to become idle
